Imports JSON runtime capture directories into a Solana capture output file.

# Purpose
`fd_solcap_import` is a command-line tool that reads a directory of JSON runtime capture files and writes the data into a Solana capture file through `fd_solcap_writer`. It parses each input file with `cJSON`, converts bank preimage fields and account records into the internal `fd_solcap_BankPreimage`, `fd_solcap_AccountMeta`, and account table formats, then stores the result in the output file. The code handles Base58 decoding for hashes and keys, and Base64 decoding for account data.

The file also sets up the memory services needed by the import process. It creates an anonymous workspace, a scratch allocator, and a heap allocator, then uses them while reading files and decoding JSON content. The [`read_json_file`](<#read_json_file>) helper loads each file into workspace memory before parsing, and [`write_slots`](<#write_slots>) walks the input directory, reads each regular file, and writes one bank preimage and its accounts for each slot. The [`main`](<#main>) function provides command-line handling, output file setup, writer setup, and cleanup.
